author: QuantumRads
quote: Is this game a 0/10? No, absolutely not. But it’s not a 10/10 either, despite critics handing out perfect scores while pointing out its flaws. There’s less freedom than in GTA 4 or 5. You can’t pull out your gun or steal cars in safe zones. You can’t hire an escort or shoot up clubs, and the writing feels like it came from an NPC. Beautiful world, terrible story.
